item.title: Sakana Fugu
item.description:
📝 01 One API to Access All in an Optimized Way 一つのAPIで、複数モデルを最適に活用 Access a coordinated pool of specialized models through one API. Fugu handles model selection and switching for each task, reducing API complexity while improving cost-performance. 専門特化型のモデル群を、一つのAPIから利用することができます。タスクごとのモデルの選択と切り替えは Sakana Fugu が担うため、APIまわりの煩雑さを抑えつつ、コストパフォーマンスを高められます。.
🔗 Read more: https://sakana.ai/fugu/

item.title: There is minimal downside to switching to open models
item.description:
📝 Open models are served via various means, some by the companies that released them and some by third parties like OpenRouter. This doesn’t feel like 2008 Linux vs Windows, it’s much closer. And unlike when I addressed this previously, the current leading open models generally are MIT licensed which I do consider open source, though many don’t.
🔗 Read more: https://www.marble.onl/posts/cancel_claude.html
